title: Visit Aseptic Apartment 1

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: You took your sweet time...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You took your sweet time...

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Never mind all that, it's not important.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never mind all that, it's not important.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: The security in this building is not fit for purpose. You might as well have invited me in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The security in this building is not fit for purpose. You might as well have invited me in.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: I'm afraid I cannot divulge that information at this time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid I cannot divulge that information at this time.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Ok, ok, ok. Fine! Look my employer is not only finished with you, they have decided to sever all ties with me too and they don't leave loose ends...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, ok, ok. Fine! Look my employer is not only finished with you, they have decided to sever all ties with me too and they don't leave loose ends...

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: You think I got this way falling off a HOVA Board?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I got this way falling off a HOVA Board?

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: We need to get to the bottom of this Aseptic case before my employer finds us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We need to get to the bottom of this Aseptic case before my employer finds us.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: How else would I get you to comply?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How else would I get you to comply?

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Fine... Will you help me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine... Will you help me?

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Well as we established, you don't have a choice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well as we established, you don't have a choice.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: That's the spirit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the spirit.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Right... Ok, well let's get started then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right... Ok, well let's get started then.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: That's why we should work quickly. They could be here at any moment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's why we should work quickly. They could be here at any moment.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Do you remember what DeeDee told you? About Gen-Debters being the most valuable financial asset in Nivalis?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you remember what DeeDee told you? About Gen-Debters being the most valuable financial asset in Nivalis?

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Bingo. Do you have any idea how expensive I am? Surely you didn't think we were working to protect the public interest, did you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bingo. Do you have any idea how expensive I am? Surely you didn't think we were working to protect the public interest, did you?

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: You thought you were special? That the algorithm said you were the only poor person in the city who could help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You thought you were special? That the algorithm said you were the only poor person in the city who could help?

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: You were just another number on a Curzona data-sheet. The law of averages - eventually one of you was going to get to the bottom of it. Well, so we thought.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You were just another number on a Curzona data-sheet. The law of averages - eventually one of you was going to get to the bottom of it. Well, so we thought.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: I forget. Hundreds probably? It wasn't easy keeping track of you all. But it did become easier as Aseptic started knocking you off one by one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I forget. Hundreds probably? It wasn't easy keeping track of you all. But it did become easier as Aseptic started knocking you off one by one.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: To think of this city in binary terms like 'good' and 'evil' is folly. We are gliding inside a delicate ecosystem, constantly on the edge of collapse.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To think of this city in binary terms like 'good' and 'evil' is folly. We are gliding inside a delicate ecosystem, constantly on the edge of collapse.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: So, so self-centered. I'm not here for you. I'm here for your Automata.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, so self-centered. I'm not here for you. I'm here for your Automata.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Oh, I think Ava worked out who the Aseptic was a while ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I think Ava worked out who the Aseptic was a while ago.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Since I started using Ava to communicate with you, I discovered an increasingly large series of files buried under extreme encryption.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Since I started using Ava to communicate with you, I discovered an increasingly large series of files buried under extreme encryption.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: I've been tracking you both. That folder grows every single time you visit an Aseptic crime scene. I need you to persuade her to reveal the contents.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been tracking you both. That folder grows every single time you visit an Aseptic crime scene. I need you to persuade her to reveal the contents.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: We're all dead anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're all dead anyway.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: What are you waiting for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you waiting for?

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Correct.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Correct.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: No need to get so attached to a machine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No need to get so attached to a machine.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Well I think your 'friend' knows exactly who the Aseptic is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I think your 'friend' knows exactly who the Aseptic is.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: No you fool.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No you fool.

nodes.speaker: Gamova
nodes.text: Your words are as meaningless as your presence in this case.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your words are as meaningless as your presence in this case.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How did you get in here?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How did you get in here?!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How did you get in here?!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How did you get in here?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I demand you tell me how you broke in here!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I demand you tell me how you broke in here!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I demand you tell me how you broke in here!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I demand you tell me how you broke in here!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you doing here? And what happened to you? You look terrible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing here? And what happened to you? You look terrible.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you doing here? And what happened to you? You look terrible.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you doing here? And what happened to you? You look terrible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine, I'm leaving ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine, I'm leaving ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Us? We're the loose ends?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Us? We're the loose ends?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So now what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So now what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks for leading them straight to me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for leading them straight to me!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks for leading them straight to me!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks for leading them straight to me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Get to the bottom now? We've been on this for what ... months?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get to the bottom now? We've been on this for what ... months?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Get to the bottom now? We've been on this for what ... months?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Get to the bottom now? We've been on this for what ... months?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could have tried asking!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could have tried asking!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well seeing as I don't have a choice...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well seeing as I don't have a choice...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well seeing as I don't have a choice...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well seeing as I don't have a choice...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Absolutely not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Absolutely not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Before we go any further, I demand you tell me who your employer was?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Before we go any further, I demand you tell me who your employer was?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Before we go any further, I demand you tell me who your employer was?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Before we go any further, I demand you tell me who your employer was?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Curzona.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Curzona.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean... Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No... Obviously not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No... Obviously not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How many of us were you using as puppets?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How many of us were you using as puppets?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How many of us were you using as puppets?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How many of us were you using as puppets?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you outsourced the leg-work to innocent people. I guess that's smart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you outsourced the leg-work to innocent people. I guess that's smart.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you outsourced the leg-work to innocent people. I guess that's smart.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you outsourced the leg-work to innocent people. I guess that's smart.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's evil. Even for Curzona.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's evil. Even for Curzona.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So if you used so many people, why are you here? Why me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So if you used so many people, why are you here? Why me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So if you used so many people, why are you here? Why me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So if you used so many people, why are you here? Why me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava? What does she have to do with this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava? What does she have to do with this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ava? What does she have to do with this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ava? What does she have to do with this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That can't be true. How would you know that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That can't be true. How would you know that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That can't be true. How would you know that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That can't be true. How would you know that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That could be anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That could be anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can try...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can try...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And if I don't?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if I don't?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If Ava knew anything, she'd tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If Ava knew anything, she'd tell me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If Ava knew anything, she'd tell me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If Ava knew anything, she'd tell me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No chance, back off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No chance, back off.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's not just a machine, she's a friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's not just a machine, she's a friend.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's not just a machine, she's a friend.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's not just a machine, she's a friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, is DeeDee Aseptic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, is DeeDee Aseptic?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Clearly you weren't worth it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Clearly you weren't worth it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Curzona?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Curzona?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why me then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why me then.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think we're in danger?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think we're in danger?
